jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Senior Implementation Manager serves as a senior member of the Implementation Team and is responsible for leading the organization's most complex, strategic, and high-visibility client implementations. This role serves as the primary client-facing partner throughout implementation and provides leadership through execution, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and operational readiness. The Senior Implementation Manager partners closely with Product, Implementation Consultants, Implementation Analysts, Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, Release Management, Account Management, and Executive Leadership to ensure successful implementation outcomes. While this role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to mentor team members, drive implementation best practices, and serve as an escalation point for complex delivery challenges. The Senior Implementation Manager facilitates implementation planning, monitors progress against agreed-upon milestones, identifies risks and dependencies, and drives cross-functional coordination to support successful client launches.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary implementation lead for the organization's largest, most complex, and highest-profile client programs.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with client stakeholders, executive sponsors, and internal leadership teams.
* Coordinate implementation activities across Product, Operations, Training, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and other cross-functional teams.
* Partner with Product, Portfolio Management, and delivery teams to establish implementation schedules, milestone plans, and dependency tracking.
* Maintain visibility into implementation progress and proactively identify, communicate, and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies.
* Facilitate executive-level client meetings, steering committees, status reviews, and implementation governance sessions.
* Support launch readiness activities by coordinating operational, technical, and client readiness workstreams.
* Drive resolution of complex implementation issues through collaboration, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Maintain implementation documentation, decisions, action items, risks, and approvals throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Partner with Account Management to support client satisfaction, organizational transitions, and long-term customer success.
* Provide implementation leadership during post-launch stabilization and transition to ongoing operational support.
* Mentor and support Implementation Managers by sharing best practices, providing guidance on complex situations, and promoting consistency across the implementation organization.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives, implementation standards, templates, governance practices, and operational efficiencies.
* Provide implementation status updates, portfolio insights, and risk assessments to senior leadership as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* SUCCESS MEASURESSuccessful delivery of strategic and complex client implementations.
* Early identification and mitigation of implementation risks and dependencies.
* Strong client satisfaction and stakeholder engagement.
* Consistent implementation practices across teams.
* Effective cross-functional collaboration and escalation management.
* Successful mentorship and development of implementation team members.
* High-quality launch readiness and post-launch stabilization outcomes.

Qualifications:

* Not provided in source content, add required education, experience, certifications, etc.
* (Preferred) Not provided in source content, add preferred education, experience, certifications, etc.

Pay Range: USD $111,300.11 - USD $139,125.13 /Yr.

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The HR Onboarding Specialist is responsible for managing the onboarding, compliance, and occupational requirements for all hires joining Ensemble. This includes both traditional hires and those joining via client integrations. The HR Onboarding Specialist is an integral part of the business ensuring an elevated new hire experience while managing the complexities of client onboarding requirements.

**Job Competencies:**

**Valuing Differences** - Works effectively with individuals of diverse cultures, interpersonal styles, abilities, motivations, or backgrounds; seeks out and uses unique abilities, insights, and ideas. Considers the collective.  
**Collaboration** - Works cooperatively within teams and partners with others, both internally and externally as needed, to achieve success; focuses on the results of the team, not the achievements of one person. It’s “All for One and One for All”.  
**Accountability** - Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed. Someone who is willing to step up and own it.  
**Developing Trust** - Gains others’ confidence by acting with integrity and following through on commitments; treats others and their ideas with respect and supports them in the face of challenges.  
**Takes Initiative** - Takes prompt action to accomplish goals and achieve results beyond what is required; is proactive and pursues relentlessly.  
**Time Management** - Effectively manages personal time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.

**Essential Job Functions:**

  

* Manage onboarding and occupational health requirements for assigned book of business. This includes new client intake discussions, identifying process bottlenecks, and creating streamlined approaches to maximize efficiencies.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures on assigned book of business to train peers and support cross functional collaboration across the team.
* Interpret occupational health medical results and determine appropriate vaccinations required based on assigned clients to ensure compliance with Joint Commission requirements.
* Responsible for navigating conversations with new hires and integrating associates to guide them through the onboarding process and ensure all items are completed timely and compliantly.
* Provide exceptional candidate experience to new hires while maintaining strong relationships and communication across all internal and external onboarding partners including background and occupational health vendors, HR, Talent Acquisition, and hiring leadership teams.
* Review onboarding requirements for accuracy and determine employment eligibility based on findings.
* Consistent partnership with Talent Acquisition Leadership to review escalations and proactively mitigate risks.
* Navigate difficult conversations with heightened discretion to properly rescind offers, push start dates, and discuss background findings with new hires while maintaining confidentiality.
* Maintain understanding of internal and external system integrations to troubleshoot any system gaps and enable cross functional collaboration with our IT, Workday, and External partners.
* Continuously refine and implement onboarding controls and audits to reduce risk.
* Execute additional HR projects as assigned.

**Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* 3-5 years of previous experience in a similar field, talent onboarding experience is preferred
* Clear communication and problem solving skills required
* Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
* Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**:

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

**What Success Looks like**:

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years leading complex implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.

**Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:**  
  
First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.  
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

* Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
* Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
* 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
* Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

**What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!**  
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!  
  
***The salary range for this position is approximately $80-90K USD annually.*** *This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.*

jobs.title: Jr. Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Jr. Implementation Specialist  
**Department:** Operations  
**Location:** Remote  
**Reports To:** Director of Implementations

**Job Overview:**

HCIactive is looking for a Junior Implementation Specialist who will guide clients through the onboarding process and ensure the successful deployment of software solutions. This role focuses on understanding client needs, configuring the platform to meet their requirements, and providing ongoing support throughout the implementation lifecycle. The Implementation Specialist will collaborate closely with clients, project managers, and technical teams to ensure smooth transitions, deliver customized solutions, and build strong relationships.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Client Onboarding:**  
  Serve as the primary point of contact during the onboarding process, ensuring clients are set up correctly and all necessary steps are taken for a smooth implementation.
* **Solution Configuration:**  
  Customize and configure the company's platform based on client specifications, ensuring that all solutions are tailored to meet each client's unique needs.
* **Project Coordination:**  
  Collaborate with project managers and technical teams to establish timelines and milestones for each implementation. Track progress, manage expectations, and address any issues that arise during the process.
* **Client Training & Support:**  
  Provide comprehensive training to clients on how to effectively use the platform. Conduct virtual or in-person sessions, and offer ongoing support to answer questions or troubleshoot issues.
* **Requirements Gathering:**  
  Work closely with clients to gather their business needs and requirements. Translate these into actionable technical specifications for the product team and developers.
* **Quality Assurance & Testing:**  
  Ensure that all implemented solutions are thoroughly tested before going live. Identify and resolve any issues that could impact the performance or functionality of the platform for the client.
* **Documentation:**  
  Maintain detailed documentation of the implementation process, including client requirements, configurations, timelines, and any challenges encountered. Provide handover notes to support teams for post-implementation assistance.
* **Client Relationship Management:**  
  Build strong, long-term relationships with clients by providing exceptional service throughout the implementation process. Act as an advisor, ensuring clients maximize the value of the platform.
* **Feedback Loop:**  
  Collect feedback from clients regarding the implementation process and the platform’s functionality. Share insights with product and development teams to continuously improve the software.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education:**  
  Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
* **Experience:**
* + 1-3 years of experience in software implementation, client success, or technical support, preferably within the insurance or Insurtech industry.
  + Experience with SaaS platforms, including cloud-based technology solutions.
* **Skills:**
* + Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand software platforms and their configuration.
  + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical users.
  + Highly organized and detail-oriented, with project management skills to manage multiple client implementations simultaneously.
  + Proficient with implementation tools, project management software, and CRM platforms.
  + Problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues and offer quick solutions.
  + Strong customer service orientation, with a commitment to client success.

**Key Competencies:**

* **Client-Centric Mindset:**  
  Ability to understand and prioritize client needs, ensuring their success with the platform.
* **Technical Proficiency:**  
  Deep understanding of software solutions, configuration options, and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues.
* **Collaboration:**  
  Skilled at working with internal teams, including developers, project managers, and customer success to deliver seamless implementations.
* **Adaptability:**  
  Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where each implementation may present new challenges.
* **Communication:**  
  Strong verbal and written communication skills, enabling clear dialogue with clients and internal teams.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision)
* Retirement plan with company match
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible work environment and remote work options.

The company does not offer H-1B visa sponsorship and will not sponsor H-1B visas now or in the future.

Salary: $50,000 - $60,000 based on experience

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Onboarding Specialist  
**Location:** Remote  
**Type:** Full-Time  
**Starting Salary:** $65,000 (potential adjustments based on experience)  
**Reports to:** Director of Customer Onboarding  
  
**Associations create change. We amplify it.**  
  
Novi AMS helps associations amplify the impact they create for their members and industries. We started in an association boardroom, and everything we build is designed with our association partners in mind.  
  
**About the role**  
  
Onboarding is where a customer’s relationship with us really begins, and we’re looking for a people-centered Onboarding Specialist to lead new customers through their onboarding journey with Novi AMS. This is a project and change management role: you will guide multiple simultaneous customers from kickoff through go-live, managing the moving parts of each project while helping customer teams navigate the change that comes with adopting new software.  
You will own the customer experience across onboarding, act as a trusted advisor to customer teams, and coordinate closely with internal teams to keep every project moving. The ideal candidate combines strong project and change management skills with sharp problem-solving, a consultative mindset, empathy, facilitation ability, and a bias toward anticipating problems before they arise. In short, you’ll pair structure with empathy, keeping projects on track while helping customers feel confident every step of the way.  
  
**What you’ll** **do**  
  
*Customer Onboarding Project Leadership*

* Lead several customer onboarding projects simultaneously, from kickoff through go-live, managing scope, timeline, milestones, and deliverables for each.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted guide for customers throughout onboarding.
* Build and maintain project plans in Rocketlane, tracking progress, dependencies, and risks across concurrent projects.
* Facilitate kickoff, status, and milestone meetings with clear agendas, decisions, and next steps.
* Anticipate roadblocks and surface risks early, driving resolution before they affect timeline or customer experience.
* Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to prepare for meetings, summarize conversations, draft communications, and keep project details organized, applying your own judgment to validate the results.

*Change Leadership & Customer Enablement*

* Guide customers through the process and organizational change that comes with adopting new software, setting clear expectations and building confidence at each stage.
* Translate customer goals into a structured onboarding path, helping stakeholders understand what is changing, why, and what is required of them.
* Coach customer teams through adoption, addressing hesitation and building buy-in across stakeholders.
* Act as a consultant to customers, recommending best practices and helping them make informed decisions about their configuration and processes.
* Train new customers on Novi AMS, so they leave onboarding confident and self-sufficient.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Coordinate handoff from Sales at kickoff and to the Support and Success teams at go-live, so customers experience one continuous relationship with Novi.
* Partner with Data, Content Migration, Support, and other internal teams to coordinate handoffs and keep onboarding projects moving.
* Collaborate across departments to support related projects and initiatives as needed.
* Communicate customer needs, risks, and dependencies clearly to internal stakeholders.
* Surface product feedback and feature requests from onboarding conversations so customer insight reaches the right teams.

*Documentation & Knowledge Management*

* Keep records accurate and current in Rocketlane, Tettra, and update other onboarding-related documentation.
* Capture and share process improvements and project learnings to strengthen the team’s collective knowledge.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of onboarding playbooks, templates, and standards.

*Customer Support & Coverage*

* Provide coverage for the Support team during their weekly team meetings, and serve as backup or additional coverage when needed or requested.
* Help ensure a seamless customer experience across onboarding and support touchpoints.

*Professional Development & Continuous Improvement*

* Participate in weekly Onboarding Specialist meetings focused on skill-building and process development.
* Apply new frameworks and methods - in project management, change management, facilitation, and communication - to live onboarding work.
* Seek out opportunities to grow as a strategic project and change leader.

  
**What you’ll need to be successful**  
  
**Exceptional written communication**  
You communicate clearly, warmly, and with purpose. You know how to make technical concepts understandable, adapt your approach to different audiences, and provide answers that feel both personal and actionable. Whether you’re leading a kickoff call, a workshop, or writing a project recap, your communication is one of your most important tools.  
  
**Technical curiosity and independent troubleshooting**  
You enjoy figuring out how things work and why they sometimes don't. You approach problems methodically, ask thoughtful questions, and use available resources to investigate before escalating. You're comfortable saying "I don't know yet" because you're confident in your ability to find out.  
  
**Practical AI fluency**  
Hands-on experience using AI tools to research, solve problems, or improve workflows, with the ability to evaluate their output and recognize when human judgment is needed.  
  
**A creative, customer-focused mindset**  
You look beyond the immediate question to understand what the customer is trying to accomplish. When the original approach isn't possible, you explore alternatives and help them find a path forward. You want customers to walk away not just with a solution, but with new ideas and a better understanding of what's possible.  
  
**Ownership and good judgment**  
You take responsibility for moving things forward while balancing thoroughness with efficiency. You know when a question needs a quick answer, when to dig deeper, when to ask for help, and when to escalate. You manage competing priorities, advocate for customers, and follow through on commitments without needing to be reminded.  
  
**Initiative and adaptability**  
You're comfortable trying new approaches, learning from what works (and what doesn't), and adjusting as you go. You welcome feedback, embrace change, and aren't afraid to challenge an existing process when you see an opportunity to make it better.  
  
**Systems thinking**  
You recognize that individual onboarding projects often reveal bigger opportunities. You notice patterns, connect information across different sources, and think about how solving a problem once could prevent it from happening again.  
  
**What success looks like**  
  
Within your first six months, you’ll be independently leading several onboarding projects from kickoff through go-live, with the product knowledge and confidence to guide customers through key configuration decisions.  
  
You’ll be running focused, productive meetings, keeping Rocketlane and Tettra current, and partnering closely with Sales, Support, and Success so every handoff feels seamless to the customer.  
  
Beyond individual projects, you’ll be contributing to the playbooks, templates, and standards that make onboarding better for every customer who comes after.  
Most importantly, customers will finish onboarding feeling confident, capable, and excited about what they can accomplish with Novi.  
  
**What you'll bring**

* 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation, project management, or a comparable customer-facing role.
* **Strong project management skills** - able to plan, organize, and lead multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and deadlines.
* **Change management capability** - experience guiding people or organizations through transitions with empathy and structure.
* **Ability to lead without authority** - influences and drives outcomes across customer and internal teams without relying on formal reporting lines or positional power.
* **Strong problem-solving skills** - diagnoses root causes and resolves issues before they escalate.
* **Consultative approach** - acts as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding decisions and recommending best practices rather than simply executing requests.
* **Strong meeting facilitation skills** - able to run focused, productive meetings that drive decisions and next steps.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain processes clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Customer-facing experience with a service-oriented, empathetic approach.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail across multiple projects at once.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve your work, with a willingness to experiment and learn as the technology evolves.
* Comfort learning and using software tools (e.g., Rocketlane, Tettra) to manage work and documentation.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a remote team environment.
* Authorization to work in the United States and availability to work 8 AM – 5 PM in your local time zone (Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific).

  
**Bonus points for experience with:**

* **Strongly Preferred:** Experience using Novi AMS
* Experience in a SaaS onboarding, implementation, or customer success role.
* Familiarity with associations, nonprofits, or membership-based organizations.
* Formal project management or change management training or certification (e.g., CAPM, PMP, Prosci).
* Experience with project management tools (Asana, Monday, Wrike, or similar).
* Training in meeting facilitation, crucial conversations, or negotiation.

  
**Why join Novi?**

jobs.description:
**Independent Lean Implementation Consultant (Manufacturing) – North America**

  

**About the work**

CCi helps manufacturers **improve performance quickly and make the gains last**.

  

Engagements often begin with a **Rapid Deployment phase**. In this phase we analyze losses and waste at site level, turn the biggest opportunities into focused improvement projects, and coach the site teams to deliver them through a clear governance cadence.

This phase also introduces the operational excellence concepts that underpin our longer-term TRACC programmes, so the site is ready to build on its early results.

  

We’re looking for **experienced, English-speaking Lean Consultants** who can lead this work on the ground, combining hands-on manufacturing expertise with the ability to coach, influence and deliver through others.

**What you’ll do**

* Coach site teams to lead their own improvement projects, building their confidence and capability in Lean, TPM and structured problem solving rather than doing the work for them.

* Carry out loss and waste analyses with the site, quantifying and costing losses in OEE, yield, waste, labour and changeovers.

* Help the site prioritize opportunities and turn them into scoped, chartered projects with clear owners, targets and timelines.

* Set up governance: project reviews, steering meetings, action tracking and benefits reporting.

* Introduce key operational excellence concepts, such as daily management, leader standard work and problem-solving routines, to prepare the site for a longer-term programme.

* Make sure benefits are validated and sustained, with standards in place before projects close.

* Engage people from operators to site leadership, so the client owns the results.

* Report progress against agreed engagement deliverables.

  

**What we’re looking for**

  

* + An outstanding **implementation consultant** who knows how to build capability and lead through others, not simply deliver the solution themselves.
  + **10+ years’ manufacturing operations experience**, including hands-on continuous improvement responsibility.
  + Industry experience, ideally within **food & beverage, chemicals, pharmaceuticals or FMCG**.
  + Strong Lean manufacturing expertise, including approaches such as **TPM, SMED, 5S, leader standard work and root cause problem solving**.
  + A strong track record of delivering improvement projects with **measurable, financially validated and sustainable results**.
  + Fluent English, with the credibility and communication skills to coach on the shop floor and engage senior management.
  + Comfortable travelling to client sites, typically **2–3 days per week**.
  + **Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification**.
  + A qualification in **Industrial, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering.**
  + Authorised to work in the country in which you are being engaged.

  

* **Nice to have**

* Even better if you bring:
  + Previous **consulting or interim transformation experience**.
  + Hands-on experience with **loss trees, cost deployment or similar loss-analysis approaches**.
  + Experience working across different manufacturing sites, environments or cultures.
  + Experience coaching teams through change and embedding new ways of working.

**What we offer**

* This is an opportunity to do more than advise. You’ll work **alongside manufacturing teams, turning improvement opportunities into measurable results**.
  + A **competitive day rate**, plus agreed expenses.
  + A **paid 4.5-day training programme** in CCi’s methodology and tools in **January 2027**.
  + Exposure to **international manufacturing clients** and real operational challenges.
  + The opportunity to continue with clients into longer-term TRACC programmes, with further training and development in the methodology
  + The opportunity to work with experienced manufacturing and operational excellence professionals while maintaining the flexibility of independent consulting.

**Working arrangement**

* **Flexibility with real on-site impact.**
  + You’ll work as an **independent contractor through your own registered business**, (registered in your applicable state, province, or jurisdiction), on a defined-deliverable basis.
  + This is a **client-facing, travel-based consulting role**, with site presence typically **2–3 days per week**, depending on the engagement.
  + Work away from the client site can be managed flexibly around engagement requirements and agreed deliverables.
  + Engagement locations will vary based on client needs, giving you the opportunity to work across different manufacturing environments.

**Blueprinting, item/test specifications, and development**

* Partner with Psychometrics on blueprint setup, test construction, data reviews, and standard setting inputs.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote- Eligible US Locations

**About the role and about You:**

Great support starts with great training. When our members hit a snag, our Community Support team gets them back into Watopia and helps them make the most of their Zwift experience. To help support our frontline agents, we're hiring a hands-on Training Specialist to build and maintain the training they rely on.

Our training program already has a strong foundation: a structured new hire curriculum, an established design framework, and experienced subject matter expert trainers who facilitate instructor-led training. In this role, you'll keep that program accurate and effective as Zwift evolves. When products, processes, or policies change, you'll revise new hire training and build and deploy update training to match. When the team identifies a need for refresh training, you'll build it. When something new and complex launches, you'll be a crucial part of supporting it.

You'll be a part of our Content & Learning team, who own training, user-facing self-service content, and the internal knowledge enabling Zwift's support team. In this role, you'll also be the subject-matter expert in Seismic, our learning management system, ensuring we're maximizing the benefits of the tool, keeping groups and enrollments clean, tracking completion and assessment results, and partnering with our BPO partners to close gaps.

You're organized, dependable, and easy to work with. You take direction well, own your work from start to finish, and partner effectively with your teammates. You know when to hold firm on accuracy and when to flex on format or timing. You're comfortable working outside a defined box: you pick up new tools, figure things out on your own, take on new work as the team's needs change, and handle shifting priorities with ease. You use AI thoughtfully, knowing where it speeds up work and where human validation is essential.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop new eLearning and instructor-led training (including exams and certifications) to support product launches and updated policies and procedures, while keeping existing training current.
* Build and deploy refresh training when the team identifies a need, indicated by QA results, Customer Effort Scores, or related performance data.
* Host train-the-trainer sessions to prepare subject matter expert (SME) trainers for seasonal new hire classes and update training rollouts.
* Run regular audits of training materials with SMEs to catch inaccurate, outdated, or missing information.
* Build and sustain strong working relationships with SME trainers, partner teams, and BPO leaders, rooting feedback in curiosity and respect while openly receiving it in return.
* Own Seismic (our LMS): managing distribution groups, reporting on completion and assessment results, and working with BPO leaders to close gaps. Explore unused and emerging features, while recommending ones worth adopting.

**What we're looking for:**

* 2+ years of instructional design, training, or learning and development experience.
* Experience building eLearning, instructor-led training, and assessments using ADDIE or a similar model, with tools such as Articulate or Camtasia.
* Familiar with Kirkpatrick or a similar model for measuring training effectiveness.
* Experience as an LMS administrator using tools like Seismic (formerly Lessonly), Docebo, or equivalent, including user groups, enrollments, and reporting.
* Experience facilitating virtual training, including train-the-trainer sessions, ideally with globally distributed or BPO teams.
* Flexibility with an eagerness to support your team beyond training when priorities shift, whether for a short-term need or a longer-term change in focus.

**Bonus points:**

* A passion for cycling, running, or fitness.
* Experience supporting both internal and BPO (outsourced) contact center teams.
* Familiarity with Zwift, gaming, the software industry, or fitness technology.
